entities.summary: Rafał Sylwester Wiechecki is a Polish politician. He was elected to the Sejm on 25 September 2005, getting 6,058 votes in the 41st Szczecin district, running on the League of Polish Families list. He also started cooperation with various other newspapers, including Myśl Polska, Wszechpolak (2002–2004) and Myśl.pl.
